arrays.trs: TR in seconds for each case
arrays.motions: case x frame x 6 (rotations in radians, translations in mm)
arrays.fd: case x frame; unmodified MATLAB calc_fd results

input_description: 240 frames mixing 0.06, 0.3, and 0.48 Hz motion with two displacement steps; identical input arrays supplied to MATLAB and Python.
comparison: Stable Python SOS FD agrees with historical direct-form FD within 2e-5 mm and gives identical FD < 0.3 masks for these cases. A TR=1.99 experiment exposed numerical instability in the historical direct-form polynomial and is intentionally not an equivalence fixture.
